steam-condenser issue #94 - raw Source srcds status output
n0xii/hl2dm-ds - HL2:DM dedicated server guide (app 232370, -game hl2mp)

notes: Stock Source-engine (srcds) admin set; no mod or plugin required. RCON is TCP on the same port as the game's UDP port (default 27015, set with -port on srcds_run); it is enabled purely by setting rcon_password in hl2mp/cfg/server.cfg. status serves as both info and roster: it prints 'hostname:/version:/udp/ip:/map:/players:' header lines then one '# userid [slot] "name" STEAM_x:y:z ...' line per player, so playerParse is regex, not csv (names contain spaces and quotes). kickid takes a userid or a Steam ID plus a message ('Kick a player by userid or uniqueid, with a message'); plain kick takes only a name in HL2DM, so kickid with the Steam ID is used here because the same identifier also works for banid and removeid. The engine's own usage string is 'banid < minutes > < userid | uniqueid > { kick }' - {duration} is MINUTES and 0 means permanent, and the trailing literal kick is what actually ejects a still-connected player. banid has no reason argument, so ban carries no {reason}. Bans are in memory only until writeid is run, which rewrites hl2mp/cfg/banned_user.cfg (writeip does the same for banned_ip.cfg); conventional server.cfg carries 'exec banned_user.cfg' and 'writeid'. removeid unbans live but likewise needs writeid to persist. Ban-file lines look like 'banid 0 STEAM_0:1:123456'; older engines write the minutes as a float (banid 0.000000 ...), hence the [0-9.]+ in lineIdPattern. Steam IDs appear as STEAM_0:... on some builds and STEAM_1:... on others, so the pattern accepts either universe digit. No motd command exists: the MOTD is the file named by the motdfile cvar (hl2mp/motd.txt, plus motdfile_text for clients with HTML MOTDs disabled), so motd is omitted rather than guessed. banip/addip cover IP bans and are deliberately not mapped here because playerId is a Steam ID. Hosting-company pages for this game mostly list SourceMod's sm_kick/sm_ban instead; those need SourceMod installed and are not stock, so they are not recorded as the commands.
